metadata.description: 1 metamer pair per observer generated from display midpoint DISP [0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5]. Matches the background used by GeneticColorGenerator and QuestColorGenerator. Generated in DISP space (RGBO), converted to BGYR for storage.
metadata.method: ColorSpace.get_maximal_pair_in_disp_from_pt(np.ones(dim)*0.5) in DISP space, converted to BGYR via ColorSpace.convert()

mc_params.note: means are degree-adjusted to match nominal observer at 4 deg
